bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for relief to Bemidji State University.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$800,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities for a transfer to Bemidji State University for incurred costs from storm damage and campus reforestation. This is a onetime appropriation.
